scripts.verify-score: node --input-type=module -e "import { candidate, role, buildPassport } from './src/passport.js'; const result = buildPassport(candidate, role); if (!result.readiness || !result.confidence || !result.decision) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({ readiness: result.readiness, confidence: result.confidence, risk: result.risk, decision: result.decision }));"
